name: Bull Stampede
disable: Four DC 27 Athletics , DC 27 Intimidation , DC 27 Nature (expert), or DC 27 Survival (expert) checks to guide the herd, find it paths through Stockside, or keep it in line.
routine:
(1 action) The stampede advances, trampling everything in its path. Each creature attempting to control the stampede must attempt a DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save or be caught up in the stampede, taking (2d12+15) Bludgeoning Damage damage; a creature who succeeded at a skill check to disable the hazard this round has a +1 circumstance bonus to the Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and cannot attempt to disable the hazard next round, as they must spend it extricating themselves from the stampede.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rampage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature frees the bulls from the stable

Effect The hazard rolls initiative as the bulls stampede.
